summary: A commit is a save point, a branch is a safe copy to try ideas, and a merge brings it back. You practise small commits, read a merge conflict, fix it, and explain a branch in one minute.
goal: Try a change on a branch and merge it back into main.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: git init, add and commit, and read git status before and after git add
Step 2: change a line, predict git status and git diff, then commit
Step 3: cause a merge conflict on purpose, fix it, and read git log --graph
Step 4: in my-ai-project, branch, commit, merge and delete add-status
Teach-back: say or write in 1 minute what a branch is and why you use one
Play the Git Time Traveller game to the end and see your score
